passages.note: Bill text: lets the legislature redraw mid-decade and restricts court challenges, plus a new map; his No vote on it shows only opposition to that arrangement.

rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on HB 1032 (2026), which lets the general assembly amend congressional districts mid-decade and limits court challenges; a No only rules out 'the party that controls the state legislature without outside interference'. His own words seek 'a non-partisan system of redistricting, in which no political data could be used' but name no body, so they do not separate 'independent citizens' commissions with no elected officials involved' from 'independent redistricting commissions with equal representation from both major parties'.

quotes.text: I offered an amendment to not redraw the maps now and instead establish a non-partisan system of redistricting, in which no political data could be used when maps are next redrawn in 2031.
so we definitely need to do something on redistricting
